title: Product Performance
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Products in scope
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.products p WHERE true

kpis.label: Best product by gross margin
kpis.sql: SELECT p.name FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.products p USING (product_id) JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sum(l.line_amount - l.line_cost) DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: AeroDesk Pro return rate from April 2026
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.products p USING (product_id) WHERE l.order_id = o.order_id AND p.name = 'AeroDesk Pro')

density.rule: a top-N or bottom-N list needs 5xN candidates
density.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.product_id) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.products p USING (product_id) JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'

density.rule: AeroDesk Pro sells in at least 30 orders every month from April 2026
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.order_ts >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.products p USING (product_id) WHERE l.order_id = o.order_id AND p.name = 'AeroDesk Pro') GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))

density.rule: and at least 20 a month before
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.order_ts < DATE '2026-04-01' AND o.order_ts >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.products p USING (product_id) WHERE l.order_id = o.order_id AND p.name = 'AeroDesk Pro') GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))
